name: ConnectWise ScreenConnect
description: Formerly ScreenConnect/ConnectWise Control, the go-to remote support tool for MSPs and IT teams — built specifically around the technician-helping-a-client workflow, not casual personal use. Its self-hosted deployment option (data stays on your own infrastructure) is the core value proposition versus TeamViewer/AnyDesk. Note: on-premise deployments had a critical auth-bypass CVE in Feb 2024 (patched same-day; cloud was unaffected) — confirm patch status if self-hosting.

Microphone Passthrough.comment: Webcam/camera streaming for remote hardware checks is confirmed; two-way audio isn't clearly documented

Pre-Login Access.comment: Unattended agents and "Backstage mode" (run commands without disrupting the user) support this

No Account Required.comment: Requires a licensed ConnectWise instance/technician seat

Android: Host.comment: Mobile support is confirmed for viewing/managing sessions; unclear if an Android device can itself be a controllable host

Web Browser: Client.comment: Officially supports access via major web browsers, alongside ChromeOS

NVIDIA RTX 4090.comment: An IT support tool, not benchmarked for GPU-accelerated streaming

Free Tier.comment: 14-day free trial only, no credit card required, but no permanent free tier

Personal: Monthly.comment: Licensed per concurrent technician for IT/MSP teams, not sold as a personal consumer product

Team / Business: Monthly.comment: One $30, Standard $45, Premium $55 (per concurrent technician, billed annually); Unattended Access is a separate line, from ~$30/mo per 25 devices

Team / Business: Annual.comment: Support plans are billed annually by default; pricing rose roughly 20% during 2025

Enterprise.comment: On-premises deployment is sold as a one-time license instead of the cloud subscription
